name: amberssh-native
description: GPU particle SSH terminal for Windows 11 (DirectX 12, nixie-amber aesthetic)
$comment: builtin-baseline pins the vcpkg registry commit every dependency resolves
against. Without it the versions are whatever the local registry checkout
happens to hold, which for an application whose job is transport security
means not knowing which crypto a build contains. This baseline resolves to
libssh2 1.11.1 and OpenSSL 3.6.3. Move it deliberately, not by side effect.
Per-package version>= constraints were tried and removed: they put vcpkg
into a resolution mode this registry checkout cannot serve (read-tree of
the version trees fails), so the baseline is the pin that actually works.
